_note: Clone-in hosting harness: provides containers plus an nginx vhost per hosted project (mylantite, meritick, grade5, ...). Application code lives in the hosted repos, not here — this repo owns docker-compose, nginx, PHP images, and devcontainer/MCP config. Merge does not deploy anything by itself.

G1.name: Config Validity
G1.desc: Compose file parses and the nginx config passes syntax check. PASS = both commands exit 0.

G2.name: Security
G2.desc: No secrets or credentials committed (compose, nginx, devcontainer, MCP config); .env files stay untracked; no ports exposed beyond the documented set; TLS/vhost changes reviewed for header/downgrade regressions.

G3.name: Alignment
G3.desc: Change matches the request: complete, no scope creep, hosted projects unaffected unless the change targets them.

G4.name: Runtime Health
G4.desc: After applying the change, containers come up healthy and each hosted vhost still serves. Verify with docker compose ps and a request per affected vhost.
